_meta.description: Plugin inventory for MixCoach — categorized by tier, with per-problem configs and ratings

problem_types.gain: Track level too high/low, clipping, low signal
problem_types.clipping: Digital clipping on master or individual track
problem_types.tonal_excess: Too much energy in a spectral region
problem_types.tonal_deficit: Not enough energy in a spectral region
problem_types.dynamics_toodynamic: Crest factor too high, too much dynamic range
problem_types.spatial: Stereo width issues, lack of depth
problem_types.limiting: Need for brickwall limiting on master

plugins.name: Fruity Balance
plugins.description: Simple gain/balance plugin with level meter

gain.action: Ajusta el gain {delta} dB en el plugin

plugins.name: Fruity Parametric EQ 2
plugins.description: 7-band parametric EQ with spectrum analyzer

tonal_excess.action: Selecciona Band {band}, frecuencia {frequencyHz} Hz, Q = {q}, modo {mode}, ganancia {gainDb} dB

tonal_deficit.action: Selecciona Band {band}, frecuencia {frequencyHz} Hz, Q = {q}, ganancia +{gainDb} dB

masking.action: Crea un notch suave en {frequencyHz} Hz, Q = {q}, ganancia {gainDb} dB (modo MID)

plugins.name: Fruity Compressor
plugins.description: Standard compressor with threshold, ratio, attack, release

dynamics_overcompressed.action: Sube el threshold a {threshold} dB, reduce ratio a {ratio}:1, bajando 2-3 dB de compresión

dynamics_toodynamic.action: Ajusta threshold a {threshold} dB, ratio {ratio}:1 con attack {attack}ms

plugins.name: Stereo Shaper
plugins.description: Stereo field manipulation: width, pan, phase inversion

phase.action: Invierte la polaridad del canal {channel} en Stereo Shaper

spatial.action: Ajusta el ancho estéreo a {width}% en Stereo Shaper

plugins.name: Fruity Reeverb 2
plugins.description: Algorithmic reverb with decay, pre-delay, damping, EQ

reverb.action: Configura Pre Delay = {preDelayMs} ms, Decay = {decaySec} s, High Cut = {highCut} Hz, Mix = {mix}%

plugins.name: Fruity Limiter
plugins.description: Brickwall limiter with threshold, ceiling, and lookahead

limiting.action: Ajusta threshold a {threshold} dB, ceiling a {ceiling} dBTP, lookahead {lookahead}ms

clipping.action: Activa Fruity Limiter con ceiling = {ceiling} dBTP para atrapar los picos

plugins.name: TDR Nova
plugins.description: Parallel dynamic EQ with spectrum analyzer — free

tonal_excess.action: Añade un filtro en {frequencyHz} Hz, Q = {q}, con ganancia de {gainDb} dB (puedes usar modo dinámico si prefieres)

tonal_deficit.action: Añade +{gainDb} dB en {frequencyHz} Hz, Q = {q} con TDR Nova

masking.action: Crea un notch dinámico en {frequencyHz} Hz, Q = {q}, con atenuación máxima de {gainDb} dB

plugins.name: TDR Kotelnikov
plugins.description: Wideband dynamics processor with advanced metering — free

dynamics_overcompressed.action: Sube el threshold a {threshold} dB, ratio {ratio}:1 (reduce compresión)

dynamics_toodynamic.action: Aplica compresión suave: threshold = {threshold} dB, ratio = {ratio}:1, attack = {attack}ms

plugins.name: Melda MUtility
plugins.description: Swiss-army knife utility: gain, MS, phase, polarity — free

gain.action: Ajusta el gain {delta} dB en MUtility

phase.action: Activa la inversión de polaridad en {channel} con MUtility

plugins.name: DC1A
plugins.description: Simple, punchy compressor with character — free version

dynamics_toodynamic.action: DC1A con Drive = {drive}, Mix = {mix}% (ganancia de entrada suave)

plugins.name: Valhalla Supermassive
plugins.description: Massive reverb/delay hybrid — free

reverb.action: Carga el preset '{preset}', ajusta Mix = {mix}%, Decay = {decay}s

spatial.action: Prueba el preset '{preset}' con Mix = {mix}% para crear profundidad

plugins.name: Dragonfly Reverb
plugins.description: High-quality algorithmic reverb — free / open source

plugins.name: Correlometer
plugins.description: Stereo correlation metering — free

phase.action: Usa Correlometer para monitorear la correlación estéreo en tiempo real; busca valores > 0.5

plugins.name: FabFilter Pro-Q 4
plugins.description: Industry-standard parametric EQ with dynamic bands, spectrum grab, and linear phase modes

tonal_excess.action: Band {band}: frecuencia {frequencyHz} Hz, Q = {q}, ganancia {gainDb} dB (modo {mode})

tonal_deficit.action: Band {band}: +{gainDb} dB en {frequencyHz} Hz, Q = {q}, modo {mode}

masking.action: Band {band}: notch dinámico en {frequencyHz} Hz, Q = {q}, rango {gainDb} dB, modo MID

plugins.name: FabFilter Pro-C 2
plugins.description: Premium compressor with 8 styles, sidechain, and lookahead

dynamics_overcompressed.action: Cambia a estilo '{style}', sube threshold a {threshold} dB, baja ratio a {ratio}:1

plugins.name: FabFilter Pro-G
plugins.description: Premium gate/expander with sidechain and lookahead

gain.action: Ajusta el gain de salida en Pro-G: {delta} dB (el resto del procesamiento manténlo neutro)

plugins.name: Valhalla VintageVerb
plugins.description: Premium vintage-inspired reverb with multiple algorithms

plugins.name: Seventh Heaven
plugins.description: Premium Bricasti M7 convolution reverb

reverb.action: Carga el preset '{hall}', ajusta Decay = {decay}s, Mix = {mix}%

plugins.name: UAD 1176
plugins.description: Classic FET compressor emulation — aggressive and punchy

dynamics_toodynamic.action: Ratio {ratio}:1, attack rápido ({attack}ms), release {release} (modo 'All Buttons' opcional)

plugins.name: SSL Bus Compressor
plugins.description: Classic SSL G-Bus compressor emulation — glue and punch

dynamics_overcompressed.action: Baja el ratio a {ratio}:1, attack = {attack}ms para dejar respirar el bus

dynamics_toodynamic.action: SSL Bus Comp: ratio = {ratio}:1, attack = {attack}ms, release = {release}ms, con {makeupGainDb} dB de makeup

plugins.name: bx_control V2
plugins.description: Premium stereo control: M/S, correlation, width, solo

phase.action: Ajusta la correlación con bx_control: revisa el medidor de correlación en el panel Stereo

spatial.action: Ajusta el ancho estéreo a {width}% con bx_control V2 o usa Stereoizer si quieres más amplitud

plugins.name: Ozone 11
plugins.description: Complete mastering suite: EQ, dynamics, stereo, imager, limiter, and more

limiting.action: Activa el Maximizer en Ozone 11 con True Peak = {ceiling} dBTP y threshold suave

clipping.action: Usa el Maximizer de Ozone 11 con ceiling = {ceiling} dBTP para capturar los picos

tonal_excess.action: Abre el Equalizer de Ozone 11 y aplica un corte suave de {gainDb} dB en {frequencyHz} Hz con Q = {q}

tonal_deficit.action: Usa el Equalizer de Ozone 11 para realzar +{gainDb} dB en {frequencyHz} Hz con Q = {q}

phase.action: Activa el Imager de Ozone 11 y revisa la correlación estéreo — busca >0.5
